en.headline: Police say two rescued from sea at Hung Hom waterfront after drinking
en.dek: Firefighters pulled a man and a woman from the water early Wednesday after they entered the sea during an argument; both were unharmed and refused hospital treatment.
body: Police received a report at about 3.12am on Wednesday that a man and a woman had entered the sea at the Hung Hom waterfront promenade.
Firefighters arrived and rescued both individuals. Initial investigations suggested they were guests at a nearby hotel who had come to Hong Kong for an exchange activity.
Police said the pair had been drinking and argued under the influence of alcohol before entering the water one after the other. Officers found no suspicious circumstances.
Both were conscious after the rescue, appeared unharmed, and declined hospital treatment. They spoke Mandarin and objected to being filmed at the scene. Beer cans were left on a nearby bench.

zh.headline: 警方指紅磹海濱長廊兩男女飲酒後墮海獲救
zh.dek: 消防凌晨將一男一女救回上岸，兩人清醒無傷，拒絕送院，警方初步調查無可疑。
body: 警方於周三凌晨約三時十二分接報，指紅磹海濱長廊有一男一女墮海。
消防到場將兩人救回上岸。初步調查顯示，兩人為附近酒店住客，近日來港參與交流活動。
警方表示，兩人事前懷疑曾飲酒，受酒精影響發生口角後先後跳海，現場沒有發現可疑情況。
兩人獲救後仍然清醒，身體沒有大礙，拒絕送院。他們操普通話，一度不滿被拍攝。附近長凳遺下啤酒罐。
